mockBlocker.title: Fake Location Detected
mockBlocker.body: A mock-location app is active on your device. While it is on, your location is not tracked and you are recorded as INACTIVE.
mockBlocker.steps:
How to turn it off:
1. Open Settings > Developer options
2. Tap "Select mock location app"
3. Choose "None"
4. Return to this app
mockBlocker.stillDetected: Fake location is still detected. Make sure it is disabled, then try again.
